author: trackreco
body:
### PR description:

As per title, this PR is introducing a different version of mkFit duplicate cleaning for phase-2.
Like in the phase-1 default cleaning, both geometrical criteria and fraction of shared hits are used to mark duplicates.
However, a scaling with pT of the track candidates is introduced, tightening the conditions to mark a candidate as duplicate at high-pT.
This improves efficiency in dense environments, at the cost of a slight overall increase in fake+duplicates rate.

To be used (at HLT in phase-2), this requires an update in the corresponding JSON: https://github.com/cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit/pull/21

### PR validation:

High-pT QCD: https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/August2026/hltMTV_QCD_miniMkFitDC/plots_hlt_hltGeneral/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf
--> The new duplicate cleaning allows to recover in ~full the efficiency at high-pT, to the level of seeds (https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/August2026/hltMTV_QCD_miniMkFitDC/plots_hlt_hltPhase2Pixel/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf)

Z'(), with m(Z')=6 TeV: https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/August2026/hltMTV_ZprimeToMM_m6TeV_miniMkFitDC/plots_hlt_hltGeneral/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf
--> No significant change, because duplicate cleaning had already a limited impact on efficiency.

TTbar: https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/August2026/hltMTV_tt_miniMkFitDC/plots_hlt_hltGeneral/effandfakePtEtaPhi.pdf
--> Performance is retained, at ~ zero cost.

FYI: @cms-sw/tracking-pog-l2
title: Introduce mini-cone for mkFit duplicate cleaning in phase-2
